## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `507f74ae724cfb4764b1a477ff9a1b0d6f8146e9`
Local-runs: probe — one `git checkout` of the head on the shared checkout to grep the tree (restored at once; nothing built, run or re-run; the greps were then redone with `git grep` on the revision)
Scope: .claude/agents/os-dev.md, AGENTS.md + scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs, scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs, scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs, scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs, scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs

### ① Derived judgments

- File list is exactly two paths, both governed register rows: `AGENTS.md` (Tier H) and `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (Tier S); one Tier H path makes the whole PR Tier H, so the landing is a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` approval after this record and the seat's ACCEPT — the PR body's Human Minimum says the same. Right.
- Accept-set: none. No package, schema, export, workflow or gate script moves; the diff is 3 insertions / 3 deletions of instruction prose. Public surface: none. Right.
- The PR itself obeys the rule it writes: opened draft through the relay with `labels: [skip-changeset]` and no `assignees` (PR read: `assignees: []`, `draft: true`); the dev's report lists three writes (push, `pr_create`, report comment) and no `pr_request_reviewers`. Right.
- Line budget: `AGENTS.md` 1050 → 1050 and `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` 405 → 405 measured on `origin/main` vs the head; the ratchet's `CEILINGS` rows are `['.claude/agents/os-dev.md', 405]` and `['AGENTS.md', 1050]`, both at headroom 0, so net 0 was the only green shape. The rewritten lines measure 98 / 113 bytes (`AGENTS.md` 403–404) and 119 bytes (`os-dev.md` 38) against `MAX_LINE_BYTES = 120`. Right.
- Issue-ID lint: the new text cites a file path and a rule ordinal (`.claude/agents/os-dev.md` rule 2), no `#n`; `EXTRA_FILES` in `check-skill-id-lint.mjs` covers both files. Right.
- Labels `documentation`, `size/xs`, `skip-changeset`. Right.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is correct: neither file ships in any released package's `files[]` (`.claude/**` and the repo root are the no-publish fast lane os-dev.md names), so nothing publishes and no level is owed. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` stand line-initial in the PR body and match the claim comment and the diff (no capability widened or narrowed, no authorable key touched). `Check Changeset` on the head: success.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev report comment 6597147368 on #29367 carries three `deviations` and an empty `open_questions`:

- os-dev.md edited at net 0 instead of the order's allowed +1 — answered: the tree, not the order, is right; the ratchet holds 405/405 and 1050/1050 (the order's 1117 for AGENTS.md matches no `CEILINGS` row), so +1 would have been red. Accepted.
- The harness assign-and-request-review step skipped on purpose — answered: that is the rule under review (`pr_create` 不请不派, SKILL.md 〈路径分叉〉; ops.mjs header: a dev's `pr_create` carries no `assignees`); the PR's empty assignee list is the read-back. Accepted.
- Worktree `../objectstack-issue-29367` kept for a patch round — housekeeping, nothing for this record.

Nothing escalated. The card's filing premise (the two files disagree) is confirmed on `origin/main` lines 403–404 vs os-dev.md line 38 and is removed by the head.

### ④ Design judgment

`.claude/agents/os-dev.md` line 38 — `PR ⛔ 不带 assignees(中继虽收),席位交棒才派。` — held against the relay and the seat protocol:

- 「中继虽收」 is true: `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs` `pr_create` row has `optional: ['body', 'assignees', 'labels']` and spells an assignee leg (`POST /issues/{n}/assignees` at the number the create answered, judged by `assigned`); `validate.mjs` accepts the typed list (self-test rows 1100–1105). The key is accepted and the rule is about not sending it — the row's own comment says the leg stays for the author-is-approver fallback, never for a seat's account.
- 「席位交棒才派」 agrees with SKILL.md 〈路径分叉〉 ③ (请审 = 席位交棒: after ACCEPT and a same-head PASS the seat sends `pr_request_reviewers`; 作者是审批人 ⇒ `assign` 它; `pr_create` 不请不派; ⛔ 永不派席位自身账号) and with the ops.mjs header (the draft open summons nobody; the hand-off is the seat's stroke). The same file's write budget (line 62: `pr_create`(draft,含 labels、⛔ 无 assignees)) and the seat-side mirror `references/execution-duties.md` line 67 (卡 assignee 归 PM,dev 恒不写;PR ⛔ 不派席位账号) say the same thing. One reading only.
- The dropped half-sentence (人经席位交棒才见 PR) loses nothing a dev needs: the dev's three-write budget already excludes `pr_request_reviewers`, and the "who sees the PR when" fact lives on the seat side (SKILL.md ③, ops.mjs header). Not a finding.

`AGENTS.md` lines 403–404 — `nor the PR's: pr_create carries none; the seat sets it at hand-over, .claude/agents/os-dev.md rule 2` — held against the home and against a reader who is not a dispatched dev:

- The pointer resolves: rule 2 of os-dev.md's 六条基本规则 is 「卡 assignee 归 PM」, and its PR sub-clause is the home. The three facts restated (carries none / the seat / at hand-over) are the home's own three, so no second reading can grow between the files; the restatement is kept because a bare pointer would tell an AGENTS.md-only reader nothing.
- A seat picking a card for itself IS the seat: it opens its PR with no assignees and acts at hand-over per SKILL.md ③. A human-driven session reads a true statement of the relay fact and the actor. The `AGENTS.md wins` precedence on line 6 does not bite while the two agree, and the restatement is small enough that a future edit to either side is a one-line diff to reconcile.
- Grep of the head tree: `mirrors the card` / `set by the executor` / executor-at-`pr_create` occur in no instruction file, skill, reference, workflow or `docs/agents` page (the one `Mirrors the card` hit is an unrelated test comment in `packages/lint`). No file still teaches the old reading.
- Gates that read PR assignees: `check-half-states.mjs` H43 (pull assignees as approver coverage) and `execute.mjs` `governedReviewPlan` (`assigned` logins) both read a PR assignee as "an approver already covered" — exactly the hand-over semantics; a dev-set assignee would have read as false coverage, which this rule now forecloses. Consistent.
- Ratchet, 120-byte width and id-lint hold as measured in ①; CI readings below.

Check-runs on the head, read after every run completed (45 runs, 23 success, 22 skipped, 0 in progress): the required contexts `Lint & Repo Gates` and `TypeScript Type Check` success; `Lint · repo & tooling gates` (the job carrying `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:pm-governed-prose`) success; `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · ESLint`, `Lint · scoped ·` ×3, `Type Check · source gates`, `Type Check · consumer gates`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Type Check · debt ledger`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, `Test Core`, `Test UI`, `Dogfood Regression Gate` success; the remaining runs are expected skips (paths filter, opt-in harnesses, schedule gate).

Must-fix: none. Should-fix: none.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-hrv6ls`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：统一 PR 的 assignee 由谁设。开发 agent 用中继 `pr_create` 开 PR 时不带 assignee（中继接受这个键，只是不发），由席位在交棒时设置。AGENTS.md 的旧括注说「由执行者在 pr_create 时设置」，现改成同一说法，并指向 `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` 规则 2。
- 为什么改：两份文件说法相反，每条卡线程都在报告里重新争一遍。SKILL.md 〈路径分叉〉的「`pr_create` 不请不派」已经定了这一点。
- 风险与回滚：只改两处说明文字，各 1-2 行，行数不变，不动代码和门禁。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`AGENTS.md` 第 403-404 行，再看 `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` 第 38 行。
- 两分钟验证：`grep -rn "set by the executor at" AGENTS.md .claude/` 无结果，`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` 绿。
- 需要你做的：请 `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`（os-zhuang 或 hotlong）之一在本 PR 点 Approve。契约复审 PASS 6597255360，`Head-sha` `507f74ae`。批准后由席位落地。

席位意见：按现行 SKILL.md 判以 os-dev.md 为准，复审确认全仓不再有旧说法，同意落地。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · domain:skills#3 · head `507f74ae724cfb4764b1a477ff9a1b0d6f8146e9`

- **Shape:** `Fixes #29367`; draft, base `main`, relay-opened (`objectstack-fleet[bot]`), labels `documentation`, `size/xs`, `skip-changeset`, no assignees. Diff `origin/main...507f74ae`: 2 files, +3 −3.
- **Premise measured:** on `origin/main` `AGENTS.md` 402-403 said the executor sets the PR assignee at `pr_create`, while `os-dev.md` rule 2 said the opposite. The head removes the old reading: the review grepped the tree and found it in no instruction file.
- **Gates (check-runs at this head):** 45 runs, all completed, 23 success and 22 expected skips; `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` success. No red.
- **Contract review:** record 6597255360, `Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, head `507f74ae`, VERDICT PASS, no must-fix and no should-fix. Its `Local-runs:` line names one probe (a `git checkout` of the head on the shared checkout, restored at once; nothing built or run).
- **Declarations:** `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; nothing publishes, so `skip-changeset` (precedent PR #29717); `Check Changeset` success.
- **Accepted deviations:** `os-dev.md` stays at net 0 lines instead of the order's +1, because both files sit at their ratchet ceiling (1050/1050 and 405/405; the order's 1117 for AGENTS.md was a stale reading). The relay fact fits on `os-dev.md` line 38 at 119 bytes.
- **Out of scope:** none.
- **Landing:** `check-governed-merges --pr 29832`: Tier H (`AGENTS.md` + `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`), 6 changed lines. The PR waits on an APPROVED review from a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` account (`os-zhuang`, `hotlong`); the seat then readies it and arms auto-merge.
